The '''Lost Rodian hunters''' were a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] hunting group that had ventured onto the [[Rryatt Trail]] — a long and winding trail through the dense [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyykian]] forests. On the [[Rryatt Trail#Wroshyr Canopy|Wroshyr Canopy]] level of the trail, the hunters set up a [[Lost Rodian hunters camp|small camp]]. But they got lost in the dangerous forests and couldn't find their way out. Eventually, they went mad and attacked anyone near them.

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] the Rodian hunter [[Tressk]], who viewed these crazed Rodians as an embarrassment, asked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to kill them.
